vya_text: gU0 - atha rasakalpanA | pAradaH sarvarogANAM jvarAdInAM jetA | tathA puShTikaraH smRutaH | suj~jena tatsAdhakena sAdhitaH tadA dehalohayoH siddhaM kuryAt || 1 ||

dI0 - pArada iti | BavasindhoH pAraM dadAtIti pAradaH | ata eva rasapraSaMsAyAmuktam `tejo mRugA~gkamauleH soDhaM svenaiva tejasAM pu~jjaiH | ajarAmaratvavitaraNakalpataruM taM raseSvaraM vande' | aparamapi - `aNimAdyaShTaguNairviBUtidoShaM na saMsAramapArapAradaH | muktvaikaM rasarAjaM konyo~athAste jarApaho hyaparaH' iti | IdRuk pAradaH sudine sAdhitaH | sa ca dehalohayoH siddhiM kuryAditi tAtparyArthaH | dehasiddhirvyAdhiharatvena | SarIrArogyatA lohasiddhiSca svarNarajataSodhanakaraNAdikaH | punaH kIdRuSo rasaH | sarvarogANAM jetA | sarve ca te rogAH SarIramano~aBipannA jvaramadamUrcCAdayaH, teShAM jetA vinASakara ityarthaH | punaH kiMBUto rasaH ? puShTikara iti | puShTirdhAtupoShaNaM tAM karoti iti puShTikaraH | ata eva poShaNAdvAjIkaraNaSaktyAyamapi viKyAtaH | sudine iti | SoBanadivase jyotiHSAstroktasaumyatithinakShatrAdiyukte dine ityarthaH | tathAcoktam - `natvA guruM BairavakanyakAbaTuM dvIpAnanaM siddhamamuShya rakShitam | anta: sunIlaM bahirujjvalaM rasaM niveSayet Kalvatale SuBe dine'| anyatrApyuktam - `vijane pavanAdivarjite vA deSe saumyadine dinAdikAle | balimatra vidhAya pUjanaM ca tadanuvidhiH pratimantritaM vidhij~jaiH' iti | sAdhita iti parimANAdikena saMskAritaH | tadyathA - `raso grAhyaH sunakShatre palAnAM SatamAtrakaM | pa~jcASatpa- ~jcaviMSadvA daSapa~jcaikameva vA | palAnnyUnaM na kartavyaM rasasaMskAramuttamam | tasmAt sUtaviSuddhyarthaM sahAyairnipuNairyutaH | sarvopaskaramAdAya rasakarma samAraBet' ityAdi | saMsiddhimiti | aihikImAmuShmikIM ca | uktaM ca yataH - `baddhaH KecaratAM padaM nayeddharate vyAdhisamUhaM mUrcCitaH | jArito janmajarAvinASanaH krAmito ra~jjito BaktimuktidaH || yadi pa~jcatvagataM hi sUtakaM BakShitaM syAdamaratvakArakam | jalaukAranibaddhaH sarvajo grathito manmatharasadAyakaH | BasmAkA- ragataM girISajam asitaM BUcaraBUtisiddhidaM | pArApAramapArapAradaM tasmAt kaH karuNAkaro~aparaH' iti | deha- lohayoriti | dehaM SarIraM tasya siddhirjarAvyAdhirAhityaM lohaM suvarNAdi tasya siddhiH saMskAratvamatra vistaraBayAnna liKitam || 1 ||

vya_text: gU0 - atha pAradanAmAnyAha - rasendraH rasAnAmindra adhyakShaH, rasendraH pAradaH | rogAdisamudrAtpAradAnAtpAradaH sUtaH | svarNAdisiddhiprasavAt sUtaH | harajaH harAt jAta iti harajaH | sUtakaH sUta eva sUtakaH svArthe kaH | rasyata AsvAdyate ShaDrasatvAdrasaH | mukundaH mukunmokShaM dadAtIti mukundaH | auNAdikatvAdaH ||2||

dI0 - rasendreti | rasendretyAdirasAntAni pAradasya nAmAni rasakarmasu j~jeyAni | kaiH budhaiH | tasyeti rasasya, iti grahaNena saMkShepanAmAnyaBihitAni | anyAnyapi santi vistareNa | tathAhi - `raso mahArasaH sUtastrinetraSca trilocanaH | harabIjaScalaScaiva bIjendro~atha rasAyanaH | pAradaSca suvarNAKyo mahAvahnistathaiva ca ||lokeSa: Kecaro divyaH sauBAgyaH paramA~amRutaH | SaSihemanidhiScaiva ananto j~jAnameva ca || sUkShmaH SAntaH praBuScaiva kalikAntakaraH smRutaH | etAni rasanAmAni tathAnyAni Sive yathA' iti || 2 ||

vya_text: gU0 - atha rasaSodhanaM | rAjikA, rasono lasunaH, etayormUShAyAM rasaM pAradaM vibandhayet | iti svedanam | atha mardanaM | dinaikaM mardayet Kalve iti | kAkamAcI prasiddhA | ayAnyairmardanaM mUrcCanaM vA ityUrdhvapAtanam || || 4-12 ||

dI0 - rAjIti | rAjIrasonetyAdinA prathamataH svedanasaMskAravidhirAraByate | yato santi BUyAMsaH saMskArAH, te ke ityatrAha - `saMsvedanaM mardanamUrcCane ca utthApanaM pAtanabodhane ca | niyAmanaM dIpanameva cAShTau pUrve kRutAH karmaNi sUtakasya' iti | anyatrApyuktam - `aShTau ca rasasaMskArA dravye rAsAyane samAH | ete prathamaM kAryAH syuH paScAt sarvatra yojayet' | rasAditi rasaSodhanakarma yatpUrvamuktaM tatkarmaSabdaH upaskArAdIn praSaMsayati | yataH - `sarvopaskaramAdAya rasakarma samAraBet' ityAdivacanam | tathAhi - `upaskaraM na yo vetti tasya siddhiH kathaM Bavet' ityapi | tasmAdupa- skarANi katipayAni liKyante | tadyathA - tulABAjanaM tacca dvividhaM tulA GaNTakaM ceti; KalvaBAjanaM tacca trividhaM pAShANaKalvaM, lohaKalaM, tAmraKalvaM ca; kaNDanI sA ca dvividhA SilAkaNDanI, pAShANakaNDanI ca; vicitraKa- rparANi tAmrAdInAM BAjanAni mRuNmayAni ca; koShThikA sA ca trividhA jAlakoShThikA KarparakoShThikA BUmikoShThikA ceti; BasrikA sA ca trividhA carmaBastrikA, karparaBastrikA, muKaBastrikA ceti, nalikA sA ca dvividhA nalikA, vakranalikA ceti | nalikA lohamayI vakranalikA mRuNmayI, mUShA sA ca dvividhA pakvA apakvA ca, apakvAyA Bedo vajramUShAyAH kumBakAreNa sumRuttikayA kRutA sA pakvamUShA; tayorBedA yathA mUShA, gostanA, andhamUShA, nalikAmUShA, sampuTImUShA, DholImUShA, iShTikAmUShA, kShAramUShA, saindhavAdilavaNamUShA KarparamUShA, kokilAKyamUShA, hematAratAmralohasIsakamUShAdayaH | saNDiSaSca taddvividhaH patrasaNDiSaH, kAkamuKasaNDiSaSceti | hastakuTTakanirGA- tAdayaH sarvANi suvarNakAropaskarANi ca | puTaM taccaturvidhaM tuShapuTaM, karIShapuTam, upalapuTaM, KadirAdikAShThapuTaM ceti | yantrANi ca tadyathA - SilAyantraM, pAShANayantraM, BUdharayantraM, vaMSanalikAyantraM, gajadantaBAjanayantraM, dolAyantraM, adhaHpAtanayantram, UrdhvapAtanayantraM, niyAmakayantraM, DamarukayantraM, kaTAhayantraM, kAMsyaBAjanayantraM, pAtAlayantraM, tulAyantraM, kacCapayantraM, cakrayantraM, cAkIyantraM, vAlukAyantram, agnisomayantraM, gandhakaTahikAyantraM, mUShAyantraM, bANayantraM, garuDayantraM, sAraNayantraM, jAlikAyantraM, cAraNayantrAdIni anyAnyapi yathAyogyaM Bavanti | tatra tatra eva j~jAtavyAni | tatra teShvAdau svedanavidhimAha - `rAjIrasonamUShAyAM rasaM kShiptvA vibandhayet' ityAdivyAKyAnaM sampradAyato liKyate | yathA rAjIkAdikalkena mUShAM kRutvA tatra rasaM melayitvA upari kadalIdalairveShTayitvA tadupari caturguNena vastreNa poTTalikAM baddhvA kA~jjikAdipUrite BANDe dolAyantravidhAnena svedayet | yAvaddinatrayaM Bavati | dinagrahaNena rAtrirapi gRuhyate tenAhorAtraM svedayedityaBiprAya:, etadapi vidhAnaM tantrAntare coktaM tadyathA - `rAjikA lavaNaM hi~ggu citrakaM vyoShasaMyutam | sUtapAdamitaM sarvaM svarjikAkShArasaMyutam || Sigrapatrarasenaiva piShTvA kuNDalikAkRutam | kuryAdBUrjadale samyagathavA kadalIdale || supakve ca dRuDhevA~api vastraKaNDe caturguNe | rasaM madhye vinikShipya badhnIyAttu supoTTalIm || kShArAmlamUtravargeNa svedayecca dinatrayam | tathA svedaH prakartavyo majjitA poTTalI yathA || Bavenna ca talasparSo BANDasyA~api kadAcana' iti | dolAyanttrapramANam | `dravadravyeNa BANDasya pUrito~ardhasya tasya ca | muKe tiryakkRute daNDe rasaM sUtreNa lambitam | taM svedayenmadhyagataM dolAyantramiti smRutam|' atha pratyekasaMskArAnte mardanamuktaM tatkarma darSayannAha - dinaikaM mardayet sUtaM kumArIsamBavairdravairityAdi | eteShAM vakShyamANadravyANAM dravaiH kRutvA Kalve sUtaM mardayet, tena pratyekarasena kRutvA dinaikaM mardayedityarthaH | kumArI prasiddhA, citrakaM citrakajaTA, kAkamAcI loke `kAmaiyA'SabdavAcyA, triPalA harItakyAdikam eBiryantrapUrvakaM saMmardya paScAt kA~jjikaiH prakShAlya SodhayedityarthaH| kA~jjikairiti bahuvacanatvena jalena takreNa vA kShAlanIyam | tathAca - tantrAntare-`BavedekaikasaMskAraprAnteShu dRuDhamardanam | marditaM sthApayeddharme yAvacCuShkataro Bavet | takreNa kA~jjikenAtha SuktenoShNodakena vA | tataH sarvaM samAnIya kShAlayediti buddhimAn || tathA yantraM prakurvIta yathA na kShIyate rasaH' iti | atha svedanasaMskAramaBidhAya samprati mardanasaMskAraM darSayannAha - tataH kShiptvA rasaM Kalve rasAdardhaM ca saindhavamityAdi | tata iti | svedanapUrvakamardanAnantara tadrasaM Kalve kShiptvA mardayediti | kaiH kRutvA ? vakShyamANasaindhavapramuKadravyaiH, etanmardanaM taptaKalve~aBihitamiti sampradAyaH | tathAhi `yuktaM sUtasya sarvasya taptaKalve vimardanam | ajASakRuttuShAgniM tu BUgarBe tritayaM kShipet || tasyopari sthitaM KalvaM taptaKalvamidaM Bavet' iti | `athavA tIvraGarme ca kArayecca pramardanam' iti sampradAyaH | anAratamiti anAlasyaM yathA Bavati tathA mardayediti BAvaH | anAratagrahaNenApi anyavihitadravyairapi mardanIyaM na doSho granthAntare darSanAt | tathAhi `kShArAmlairlavaNairmUtrairviShairupaviShaistathA | divyauShadhisamUhena mardayeddivasatrayam' | anuktamAnAnAM mardanArthadravyANAM ca parimANaM granthAntarAdavagantavyam | tadyathA - `pAradasya kalAMSena BeShajena pramardayet | dravyeNa yAvatA sarvaM plutaM Bavati mardane' iti | idAnIM mardanasaMskArAdanantaraM mUrcCanasaMskAravidhimAha - tato rAjI rasonaScetyAdi | tata iti mardanasaMskArAdanantaram | rAjI rAjikA, rasonaH lasuna iti prasiddhaH, muKyaSca navasAdara iti| navasAdaraSculikAlavaNa: muKya: SreShTho grAhya ityarthaH | tasya SreShThatA paigAmISabdavAcyA prasiddhA | tadvaditi | mardanoktaprakAreNa mardyaM tuShAmbuneti | kA~jjikena kRutvA kShAlanaM svedanaM ca pUrvavat kAryaM, rasasyotthApanArthaM yato mUrcCanAnantaramutthApanamapi kAryamiti sarvatra | tathAhi - `utthitaH kA~jjikasvedAt pAtayet KalvasaMyutam' iti saMpradAyaH | yathA - `dolAsvedaM prakurvIta madhukShArAmlamUtrakaiH | utthApya mUrcCayet paScAt trivAraM ca punaH punaH' iti | athavA `tataH Kalvena taptena amlenotthApayedrasam | kShArA muKakarAH sarve sarve hyamlAH prabodhakAH' iti || mUrcCanotthApanavidhimaBidhAya samprati pAtanAnyAha - tataH saMSoShya cakrABamityAdi | tata iti mUrcCanotthApanAnantaram | saMSoShyeti | eke saMSoShyetyanena mUrcCitameva rasaM cakrABaM kRutvA pAtayediti vyAKyAnayanti tanna saMmataM bahusampradAyeShu, mUrcCitasyotthApanaM kRutvA paScAduktadravyaiH saha piShTikAM kRutvA cakrikAM kuryAdityaBiprAyaH | anyatrApyuktam | `BAgAstrayo rasasyArkacUrNa- pAdAMSasaMyutam | datvA~amlaM mardayet - tAvadyAvat piShTiH prajAyate | yadA na jAyate piShTiH - ki~jcittutthaM tadA kShipet' iti sarvatra | piShTikRutarasacakrI hi~ggunA liptvA dhAryA | hi~ggumAnamapi ShoDaSAMSaM pAradaparimANAt, dvisthAlIsampuTa iti | viKyAtaM lavaNapUraNaM sampradAyadarSanAdboddhavyam | dRuDhatarAM mudrAmiti mudrA~atra sAmpradAyikI kAryA yathA gurusakASAdvA dRuShTvA | tathA athavA sadbuddhInAM j~jApanArthaM sadAByastA mudrA~atra liKyante tathAca `valmIkamRuttikApArapUraNaM lohakiTTakam | SvetapAShANakaM caiva tatsarvaM cUrNayet samam || sarvatulyaM viShaM dagdhaM sarvaM toyairvimardayet | mUShAdisampuTaM kuryAt sarvasandhipralepane' | athavA `tuShaM BAgadvayaM grAhyaM, BAgaikaM vastraKaNDakaM | mRudaScaturguNo BAgo jalaM datvA pramardayet || narakeSaM SaNaM ki~jcit datvA tAvat prakuTTayet | yAvat sikthasamABAsaM mRutpiNDaM jAyate tadA || yathA na SuShkatAM yAti tathA yantraM samAcaret | evaM saptadinAdUrdhvaM mRudaM yoge prayojayet || kUpikAdivilepArthaM yantrArthaM ca BiShak kramAt' | aparamapi | `harItakITa~gkaNaparNacUrNaM KarI guDaM pAMSu paTuM samAMSam| valmIkamRut sarvasamA tadardhaM vastraM tathA gomayakaM ca sarvam || jalena mardyaM madanopamaM tad yantrAdisandhau viniveSanIyam' iti | aparANyapi - `lohakiTTaM tuShaM dagdhaM SukticUrNaM ca karkarA | etAni samaBAgAni tAvadBAgena mRuttikA | karpaTena samAyuktA sA hi vajropamA Bavet | dagdhatuShasyaikaBAgo mRudBAgatrayameva ca | karpaTaM SaNasaMyuktaM vajramRutsneti yojayet | iShTakAcUrNaBAgaikaM samaBAgA tu mRuttikA || mUShAbandhaH prakartavyo dhamanAdvajratAM vrajet | BAgaikaM lohakiTTasya tuShadagdhadvayaM tathA || mRudBAgatrayasaMyuktaM ki~jcit kupyaM pradApayet | ekatra kuTTayet sarvaM mRuttikAvajravadBa- yet || niShi~jcedambunopari' iti | upari ambunA niShi~jcediti ko~arthaH ? tatsthAlIsampuTayantraM cullyAM nidhAyAgniM prajvAlya tadupari SItaM jalaM punaH punaH kShipedityaBiprAyaH | sajalavastraKaNDamapi tadupari dhAryamiti sampradAyaH | anyatrApyuktam - `saMruddhya BANDadvayagarBamadhye piShTiM tataH sampuTamavraNaM tam | niveSya cullyAM tu SanaiH pradIpapramANamasyAdyatale vidadhyAt || agniM Sirasyasya jalArdramekaM vastraM kShipedalpamanuShNameva' iti | doShavivarjita iti yadgrahaNaM kRutaM tatsarvaM doSharahitaH pAradaH eBiH pa~jcaBiH saMskAropAyaireva BavatItyasyABiprAyaH | tasmAt pa~jcaiva saMskArA anenA~atra svIkRutAH | ke te doShAH ? tathAhi - `malaM viShaM vahnigurutvacApalaM naisargikaM doShamuSanti tajj~jAH | upAdhikau dvau trapunAgasamBavau rasendrarAje kathayanti vaidyAH'| nanu pAtanatrayeNaiva nAgava~ggakRutadoSho vinaShTo Bavati nAnyaiH, tathAhi - 'miSritau cedrase nAgava~ggau vikrayahetunA | syAt tAByAM kRutrimo doShastanmuktiH pAtanatrayAt' iti| tatkathamatra pa~jcaBireva sarvadoShavivarjito Bavati ? satyam, UrdhvapAtanAntargatamadhastiryakpAtanamastIti tasyABiprAyaH, tatpAtanadvayaM tantrAntarAdavagantavyam | athavA `athordhvapiTharImadhye lagno grAhyo rasottamaH' ityatrA~athagrahaNenAvaSiShTasaMskArANi sUcyante tAni ca pAtanabodhananiyAmakAnItyadoShaH || atha keShAMcijj~jApanArthaM prasa~ggataH pAtanatrayamAha - UrdhvapAtanamatraiva kathitam | adhaHpAtanaM tiryakpAtanaM ca darSayannAha - tathAca tantrAntare -‘kaTAhaM nUtanaM kRutvA tasyAdho lepayedrasam | dviguNena ca gandhena jArayedbradhnakAdayaH || vastrAntAni mRudA liptvA jalaM sthAlyupari nyaset | sthAlIkaTAhayoH sandhiM lepayet sudRuDhaM mRudA || kaTAhopari kartavyamupalAgnipradIpanam | jalamadhye raso yAti SuddhaM tiShThati bradhnake || SulbAdraso rasAt tAmraM pAtanIyaM pRuthak kRutam | sasUtaBANDavadanepyanyanmilati BANDakam | tathA sandhirdvayoH kAryA pAtanatrayayantrake | jalasthAne kA~jjikaM ca dApayennAtra saMSayaH’ iti | tiryakpAtanamapyAha - tathAhi ‘GaTe rasaM vinikShipya sajalaM GaTamanyakam | tirya~gmuKaM dvayoH kuryAt tanmuKaM rodhayet sudhIH || rasAdho jvAlayedagniM yAvat sUto jalaM viSet | tiryakpAtanamityuktaM siddhairnAgArjunAdiBiH’ iti | athAparANyapi prasa~ggato liKyante tathAhi - ‘sthUlasaindhavapoTTalyAM kAryaM mUShApuTadvayam | sthApayitvA rasaM tatra navasAraM kalAMSakam | sandhiM nirudhya yatnena veShTayet karpaTaM mRudA | sthApayedBUdhare yantre vahniM kuryAddinatrayam | yantrAduddhRutya sUto~asau svedayet tadanantaram | bIjapUraPalaM vAtha vRuntaM santyajya kArayet || saindhavena samaM sUtaM tasya madhyaM vinikShipet | svedayeddolikAyantre hyamlavarge dinatrayam || evaM hyagnisaho jAto rasendraH sarvakarmasu’ iti niyAmakam | atha bodhanamAha - ‘atha sUtaM samuddhRutya kAcakUpye vinikShipet | SuktAmlenAtha sampUrya dvAre mudrAM pradApayet || sthApayedBUdhare yantre svedayeddinasaptakam | svA~ggaSItaM samuddhRutya kaShAyaiH svedayet punaH || karkoTIka~jcukIvahnisarpAkShyambujamAdravaiH | dinatrayaM sAranAlaiH svedyaScA~jcalyaSAntaye’ iti bodhanam | atha dIpanamAha - ‘lavaNaM rAjikAhi~ggukanyAkShAracatuShTayam | tryUShaNaM lasunaM caiva mAtulu~ggarasaplutam || piNDamadhye rasaM kRutvA svedayet saptadhA punaH | anudgArI Bavettena grAsAjIrNe~api jIryati || anenaiva BavecCuddhaH sarvadoShavivarjitaH’ | athavA - dI0 - idAnIM lokanAtharasaM prakaTayannAha - Suddha iti | sUtaH pAradaH SuddhaH saMskAritaH, saMskArA hyasya pUrvaM kathitAH, buBukShitaH kShudhitaH, kAritaH dravyairiti SeShaH, sa ca BAgadvayaparimitaH, tathA gandhasya dvau BAgau tatheti grahaNena gandhakasyApi SodhanaM darSitam | tayoriti gandhakapAradayoH, sUtAccaturguNeShvevetyAdi sUtAt sUtaparimANAt | kapardakeShu varATakeShu kapardakalakShaNaM ca tantrAntarAdavagantavyam | tadyathA - `tulanAyAM gurutarAn pa~jca gulmAn daSa dvijAn | varATAn sthUlapItAMSca rasakarmaNi yojayet' iti | BAgaikaM Ta~gkaNaM dadyAditi ko~arthaH pAradaparimANAdardhaBAgaM sauBAgyakShAraM saMgRuhya gokShIreNa saha kalkIkRutyAnenaiva kalkena tAn rasagarBitavarATAn vimudrayedityaBiprAyaH | tathA Sa~gKasya KaNDAnAmiti SodhitaSa~gKasya KaNDAnAM SakalAnAM BAgA aShTau grAhyAH | pAradasyaikaBAgApekShayetyarthaH | saMpradAyastu Sa~gKaSakalAni kShIre saMSodhya paScAttenaiva kShIreNa saha SlakShNAni sampiShya paScAdanenaiva kalkena tAn varATAn lepayedityaBiprAyaH | anye tu Sa~gKaSakalAni varATikABiH saha puTet| cUrNaliptaSarAvayoriti | cUrNaM SuktikAdisaMBavaM tacca kaliSabdavAcyaM tenAliptaSarAvakau kRutvA tAByAM sampuTaM kArayedityarthaH | SarAvasampuTasandhiShu sAmpradAyikI mudrA kAryeti vyavahAraH | tadupari ca mRullepaH kArya ityapi vyavahAraH | gajapuTeneti | yathA gajapuTavidhAnaM tathaivA~atra puTedityarthaH | tacca gomayAdinA garte kRutam | ekonatriMSadUShaNairiti ekena yadUnaM maricAnAM triSattena saha ShaDraktikapramANaM BakShayet| GRutena vAtaje dadyAdityAdi | atra vAtaje pittaje kaPaje ca atIsArAdAvagre vakShyamANA niyamA boddhavyAH | tasyopari GRutAnnamiti pUrvaM rasaM BakShayitvA paScAttadupari kavalatrayaM GRutAnnaM Bu~jjIta GRutena yuktamannaM GRutAnnam | annamatrodanam | ma~jce KaTvAyAm | anupadhAnake upadhAnaM gendukaM tena rahite ma~jce iti SeShaH | etena samyaguttAnaM yathA syAttathA saMviSedityarthaH | paScAt pathyApathyamAha - anamlamityAdi | anamlam amlarasarahitam amla~jca mAtulu~ggapraBRutikam | annaM saMskRutamannaM tena BaktAdikam | GRutamiti GRutayuktaM | madhuraM dadhIti | madhuraM komalajIvitaM yadvA madhurayuktaM tattu rasAlAdi | prAyeNa jA~ggalaM mAMsamiti mAMsaBakShaNaM cAtra vihitaM bAhulyena jA~ggalaM pradhAnatamaM tadapi GRutapAcitaM kAryaM | yadyapi jA~ggalavargo~aShTavidhaH | tadyathA - jA~ggalA viShkarAH pratudA guheSayAH prasahA parNamRugA bileSayAH grAmyASceti | tathApyete tu rogApekShayA deyAH, GRutapAcitamiti tailaniShedhAt guNAdhikyAcca | tathAhi - `mAMsaM yattailasiddhaM tu vIryoShNaM pittakRudguru | laGvagnidIpanaM grAhyaM ruciM dRuShTiprasAdanam | anuShNavIryaM pittaGnaM manoj~jaM GRutasAdhitam' iti | GRutAniti GRutasAdhitAn athavA sarpiShA GRutena snAnaM kuryAt, koShNodakena snAnaM tu adhaHkAyasyeti | yataH `uShNAmbunAdha:kAyasya pariSheko balAvahaH | tenaiva tUttamA~ggasya balahRut keSacakShuShAm' iti | kvacit tailaM na gRuhNIyAditi kvacit kutrApi tailagrahaNaM na kAryaM tena dIpAdiShvapi tailaM niShiddhaM syAt | atha tyAjyamAha -bilvamiti| bilvaPalaM, kAravellakaM loke `karelA'SabdavAcyam | Palamiti | vArtAkaM vRuntAkaM, SaParIM kShudramatsyAn, ci~jcA prasiddhA, vyAyAmaM SarIrAyAsajananaM karma, maithunaM strIsevA, madyAdikamiti sugamam | tyajedayuktanidrAM ceti ayuktanidrA divAnidrAdikaM | kakArAdiyutaM sarvamiti sarvamAhAranimittaM kakArapUrvakaM SAkaPalAdikaM tyajet | site pakShe Sukle pakShe agniBRuShTaM | jayAcUrNamiti jayABa~ggA, barhipakShaBasmeti barhI mayUra: | mRugA~gke mRugA~gkapoTTalike, hemagarBe hemagarBapoTTalike, mauktikAKye mauktikAKyapoTTalike apareShvapi pa~jcarajapoTTalikapraBRutiShu eSha vidhiH prayojya iti || 59-85 ||
